# Lumen Learning

> > Lumen Learning provides LTI-integrated course platforms and learning management solutions for higher education institutions across the United States.

Lumen Learning partners with community colleges and universities to deliver integrated course content and learning management through LTI (Learning Tools Interoperability) connections with institutional platforms like Canvas and Sakai. The platform serves as a bridge between educational institutions and centralized learning content delivery.

## Key Topics

- LTI Integration
- Learning Management System (LMS)
- Canvas LTI
- Course Platform
- Sakai LMS
- Institutional Partnership
- Educational Technology
- Learning Management
- LTI Consumer
- Educational Content
- Higher Education
- Community College
- Lumen Learning Platform
- Course Delivery
- Institutional Integration

## Institutional Partnerships

- [Virginia Western Community College](https://courses.lumenlearning.com/lti_consumer/virginia-western-community-college-virginia-western-community-college-canvas): Virginia Western Community College Canvas LMS integration with Lumen Learning
- [SUNY Empire State College](https://courses.lumenlearning.com/lti_consumer/suny-empire-state-college): SUNY Empire State College course platform integration with Lumen Learning
- [Texas Wesleyan University](https://courses.lumenlearning.com/lti_consumer/texas-wesleyan-university): Texas Wesleyan University LTI integration for course delivery platform
- [Mississippi State University](https://courses.lumenlearning.com/lti_consumer/mississippi-state-university): Mississippi State University institutional partnership and course platform
- [Sacred Heart University](https://courses.lumenlearning.com/lti_consumer/sacred-heart-university): Sacred Heart University higher education LTI integration for learning management
- [SUNY Albany](https://courses.lumenlearning.com/lti_consumer/suny-albany): SUNY Albany institutional partnership for LTI-integrated course platform

## Community College Integrations

- [John Tyler Community College](https://courses.lumenlearning.com/lti_consumer/john-tyler-community-college-john-tyler-community-college-canvas): John Tyler Community College Canvas LMS integration with Lumen Learning
- [Atlanta Technical College](https://courses.lumenlearning.com/lti_consumer/atlanta-technical-college): Atlanta Technical College LTI consumer integration for course platform
- [Mayland Community College](https://courses.lumenlearning.com/lti_consumer/mayland-community-college): Mayland Community College course platform with LTI integration
- [Blue Ridge Community College](https://courses.lumenlearning.com/lti_consumer/blue-ridge-community-college): Blue Ridge Community College LTI consumer for institutional course delivery
- [Holyoke Community College](https://courses.lumenlearning.com/lti_consumer/holyoke-community-college): Holyoke Community College course platform with LTI integration

## Learning Platform Implementations

- [Lumen Learning ANI mySakai](https://courses.lumenlearning.com/lti_consumer/lumen-learning-ani-mysakai): Lumen Learning ANI mySakai LMS integration for course delivery
- [Mercy College](https://courses.lumenlearning.com/lti_consumer/mercy-college): Mercy College institutional portal with LTI integration for learning management
